##### imports

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
```

### Data Loading

```{r}
data_dir <- "../data/kmer_datasets"
df_k2 <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir,"k2_s2e6_c4_freqs.csv"))
df_k3 <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir,"k3_s2e6_c4_freqs.csv"))
df_k4 <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir,"k4_s2e6_c4_freqs.csv"))
glimpse(df_k2)
```

*Check dimensions*
```{r}
cat("3-mer dataset: ",dim(df_k3),"\n4-mer dataset: ",dim(df_k4))
```

Create binary var. for cancer vs non-cancer
```{r}
k2 <- copy(df_k2)
k3 <- copy(df_k3)
k4 <- copy(df_k4)

# ABC  & EBC --> 1 (cancerous)
# ABCA & BBT --> 0 (non-cancerous)
k2["cancer"] <- as.factor(c(rep(1,6),rep(0,6),rep(1,6),rep(0,6)))
k3["cancer"] <- as.factor(c(rep(1,6),rep(0,6),rep(1,6),rep(0,6)))
k4["cancer"] <- as.factor(c(rep(1,6),rep(0,6),rep(1,6),rep(0,6)))
```


```{r}
# ABC + ABCA pairs (assumed)
pairs <- c("SRR41124801" = 1, "SRR41124800" = 2, "SRR41124798" = 3,
           "SRR41124794" = 1, "SRR41124793" = 2, "SRR41124792" = 3,
           "SRR41124797" = 4, "SRR41124796" = 5, "SRR41124795" = 6,
           "SRR41124791" = 4, "SRR41124790" = 5, "SRR41124789" = 6)
```


## PCA

```{r}
k2_pca <- prcomp(k2[, -c(1, (ncol(k2) - 1):ncol(k2))])
k3_pca <- prcomp(k3[, -c(1, (ncol(k3) - 1):ncol(k3))])
k4_pca <- prcomp(k4[, -c(1, (ncol(k4) - 1):ncol(k4))])
```

### Scree Plot

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
pca_list <- list(
  k2 = k2_pca,
  k3 = k3_pca,
  k4 = k4_pca
)

# Set up 2x2 plotting grid
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (k in names(pca_list)) {
  pca <- pca_list[[k]]

  var_explained <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100
  cumulative_var <- cumsum(var_explained)

  plot(cumulative_var,
       xlab = "Principal Component",
       type = "b",
       pch = 19,
       ylim = c(60, 100),
       ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained (%)",
       main = paste("Cumulative Scree Plot", k))

  abline(h = 90, lty = 2, col = "red")
}

# Reset plotting layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

*Investigate k=2 PC1*

```{r}
sort(abs(k2_pca$rotation[,1]),decreasing=TRUE)
```

Driven mostly by `TT`, `AA`, `GG`


```{r}
# k=3 main PCs
for (x in 1:4) {
  cat("PC", x, ":\n")
  print(sort(abs(k3_pca$rotation[, x]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:8])
}
```

Again, `TTT` is most significant


```{r}
# k=4 main PCs
for (x in 1:4) {
  cat("PC", x, ":\n")
  print(sort(abs(k4_pca$rotation[, x]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:8])
}
```

Thymine- and adenine-rich k-mers are of top significance

## Clustering

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
pca_list <- list(
  k2 = k2_pca,
  k3 = k3_pca,
  k4 = k4_pca
)

# Explicit class-to-color mapping
class_colors <- c(
  "0" = "blue",
  "1" = "red"
)

# Generate colors using the binary class variable
cmap <- class_colors[as.character(k2$cancer)]

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (k in names(pca_list)) {
  pca <- pca_list[[k]]

  plot(pca$x[, 1:2],
       xlab = "PC1",
       ylab = "PC2",
       main = paste("PC1 vs. PC2 -", k),
       pch = 19,
       col = cmap)

  legend("topright",
         legend = c("0 = Non-cancerous", "1 = Cancerous"),
         col = c("blue", "red"),
         pch = 19)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

*Check 4-class dist.*

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
pca_list <- list(
  k2 = k2_pca,
  k3 = k3_pca,
  k4 = k4_pca
)

# Explicit class-to-color mapping
class_colors <- c(
  EBC = "blue",
  BBT = "red",
  ABCA = "darkgreen",
  ABC = "orange"
)

# Match colors to sample classes
cmap <- class_colors[as.character(k2$class)]

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (k in names(pca_list)) {
  pca <- pca_list[[k]]

  plot(pca$x[, 1:2],
       xlab = "PC1",
       ylab = "PC2",
       main = paste("PC1 vs. PC2 -", k),
       pch = 19,
       col = cmap)

  legend("topright",
         legend = names(class_colors),
         col = class_colors,
         pch = 19,
         cex = 0.8)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

k3 & k4 distributions seems largely similar
